narrative.northStar: Paper white and black with lime
narrative.overview: Paper white and black with lime. Black carries the content, the actions and every on state. Lime appears in two places only: the best release and live downloads. Red means something went wrong, amber means something is missing or waiting. Tables stay dense: 40px rows inside a 40px page margin, 8 posters per row on Library. Light mode only; the dark design is archived. These are static pen.dev components; keyboard, focus, screen reader and runtime behaviour are implementation work.
keyCharacteristics: Black for actions and on states
Lime only as a fill for the best release and live downloads
Red for problems, amber for missing or waiting
Corners 4 to 10px; shadows only on floating things
Schibsted Grotesk for the interface, Barlow Semi Condensed for data
dos: Do keep normal states quiet: monitored, meets profile, not aired, downloaded show nothing extra.
Do use black for actions and "on" states, and grey tint plus the black side bar for selection.
Do use the real service and tracker logos from the library, never drawn stand-ins.
Do write status in words, every chip as a `v2/Badge` instance.
Do use the words in CONTEXT.md: Release, Grab, Replace, Second version, Manual download, Pick a release, Search automatically.
donts: Don't put lime on white as text, icons, lines or a thin progress bar.
Don't use red for anything that has not gone wrong, or amber for decoration.
Don't put shadows on anything in the page flow, or corners outside 4 to 10px.
Don't use `faint-foreground` for readable text, or opacity for disabled.
Don't draw a coloured side bar on callouts.
Don't describe these static components as working keyboard controls or tested accessibility.
